lines: Our love story
It unfolded just as I had longed for
Now that it begins, it’s a one‑person play
Even if I stay by your side forever
In the end I’m merely a spectator
A sorry without emotion
It is as always
If I get used to it, it’s not bad, though
Our romance is a facet of life
I learned that it won’t continue
In a different setting, in a different relationship
I wish I could have chosen a world line where we could meet
With a different personality, with different values
I wish I could convey love, but wishing is futile
Goodbye
I am not the person destined for you
It hurts, yet undeniable, and I can’t let go
Just touching that hair hurts
Even if I don’t want to, it’s sweet—no, no
Goodbye
Then what are you to me?
I don’t know the answer, nor do I want to know
If there is only one certain thing
"You are beautiful"
Someone pompously
spouts the logic of love
Nothing at all clicks
Looking down from an airplane window
It feels like the nightscape of an unfamiliar city
In a different setting, in a different relationship
I wish I could have chosen a world line where we could meet
With an utterly pure heart, I embrace the love that came true
It would be nice to say "I love you" irresponsibly
Even wishing that is empty
Goodbye
Beyond the hand we held lies the end line
Each time we stretch it, the future begins to throb
You are not there, and that fact makes me cry...
That’s painful, isn’t it
Goodbye
I am not the person destined for you
It hurts, yet undeniable, and I can’t let go
Just touching that hair hurts
Even if I don’t want to, it’s sweet—no, no
Goodbye
Then what are you to me?
I don’t know the answer, nor do I want to know
If there is only one certain thing
"You are beautiful"
If all of this is the destiny of romance, it’s not so bad
There is no eternity nor promise, yet
"Very beautiful"
